limitations: Repeated fits share originating cases and are not independent evaluation samples.
Repeated deterministic ridge views can represent one fit, not three independent fits.
A scalar comparison does not authenticate data, process closure or scientific novelty.
No model, fit, simulator or independent causal rollout is replayed.
Training orders and counts are checked as records; optimizer execution is not replayed.
TRAIN-derived variance is authenticated metadata, not independently recomputed from TRAIN arrays.
Three ridge views repeat one fit; repeated neural fits share cases.
This audit cannot admit old TEST, confirmation or new execution.
